run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T00:17:35Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for frontend-proxy is defined in the loaded otel-demo rule file as sum by(service_name,namespace)(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR",service_name!~"flagd|load-generator"}[2m])) > 0 with for: 1m, i.e. it fires on any nonzero ERROR-status span rate. At 2026-11-18T00:17:35Z that expression evaluates to exactly 0.022222/s for frontend-proxy, the value carried in the alert, and it is composed only of "ingress" error spans (no "router frontend egress" errors) - the same ingress-only pattern seen before the incident. The one real deviation in the window was at ~00:09:30, when the same expression reached 0.644444/s with paired "ingress" and "router frontend egress" error spans; the errors were confined to checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans and frontend's POST/api/checkout / grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans. That burst coincides with the payment Deployment rollout at 00:07:57 (kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt, unchanged image tag 2.1.3-payment): the old pod was stopped at 00:08:00, the new container started at 00:08:00 but logged "payment gRPC server started on port 8080" only at 00:09:15.571, and the payment container declares no readiness/liveness/startup probe, so traffic was routed to a non-listening pod for about 75 s. Separately, the ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config contains the only switched-on fault-injection setting in the cluster, paymentUnreachable = "on" ("Payment service is unavailable"), which names the restarted workload; a causal role for that setting is a hypothesis, not established, because payment served charges successfully at 00:20:54-00:21:54 while the setting was still on and its own error-span metric stayed at 0. The alert's activeAt is ~8 min after the burst and at background level, so the firing instance itself is not clearly tied to the burst.

claims.text: The loaded otel-demo alerting rule file defines RequestErrorRate as sum by (service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", service_name!~"flagd|load-generator"}[2m])) > 0 with for: 1m and severity warning, so any nonzero rate of ERROR-status spans on a service fires it.

For service_name="frontend-proxy", sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[2m])) evaluated to 0.0222222/s at 2026-11-18T00:17:35Z (exactly the alert's current value), 0.6444444/s at 00:09:30Z, 0 at 2026-11-17T23:52:00Z and 0 at 00:25:00Z.

frontend-proxy error spans are only of span_name "ingress" (server) and "router frontend egress" (client). At 00:17:35Z the trailing 3m increase was ingress 2.4 and router frontend egress 0; at 00:03:00Z (pre-incident) it was ingress 3.333 and router frontend egress 0; in 00:06:30-00:09:30 both were 34.8.

In the 10m window ending 00:14:00Z, the only error spans were checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (44.38) and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (44.38) and frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (72.63), executing api route (pages) /api/checkout (72.63), POST (72.63) and POST /api/checkout (72.63); every other operation of both services was 0. The same query at 00:30:00Z returned 0 for all of them.

Checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge error-span count was non-zero in only one 1-minute window: 80.07 for the window ending 00:10:00Z; all windows sampled between 00:00:00Z and 00:24:00Z before and after it returned 0.

The payment Deployment is at generation 2/observedGeneration 2 with pod template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:07:57Z, the unchanged image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment, and Progressing condition NewReplicaSetAvailable updated 2026-11-18T00:08:00Z naming ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786.

Events show the payment rollout: Deployment payment Scaled up payment-54499f9786 from 0 to 1 at 00:07:57 and scaled down payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0 at 00:08:00; the new pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d was Scheduled 00:07:57, container Created 00:07:59 and Started 00:08:00; kubelet recorded Stopping container payment on payment-55766d76b9-846r8 at 00:08:00.

The new payment container's only log line between 00:07:57Z and 00:09:20Z is "payment gRPC server started on port 8080" at 2026-11-18T00:09:15.571Z, so the payment gRPC listener was absent for roughly 75 s after the old pod was stopped (00:08:00Z).

The payment container spec declares no readinessProbe, livenessProbe or startupProbe (all null) with containerPort 8080 and resource limits cpu 20m/memory 160Mi, and the payment Service selects opentelemetry.io/name=payment on port 8080.

Only two of the 21 otel-demo Deployments carry kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt: payment (2026-11-18T00:07:57Z) and flagd (2026-11-17T23:37:39Z, whose pod flagd-678dcfdc67-bl78w started 23:37:39); every other Deployment is generation 1 with no restartedAt annotation.

The ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config holds demo.flagd.json in which the fault-injection setting paymentUnreachable has state ENABLED, description "Payment service is unavailable", defaultVariant "on" (variants off=false, on=true); all other fault flags in the same file (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) have defaultVariant "off".

This ConfigMap is the only fault/flag configuration found in the cluster: the cluster-wide configmap scan for flag/chaos/fault/inject names or defaultVariant/fault/unreachable content returned only otel-demo/flagd-config plus unrelated clickhouse, cilium, prometheus and topology-monitor ConfigMaps.

Payment itself shows no error signal: the payment series of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} was 0 in every sampled point from 23:55 to 00:30, and payment logs show normal "Charge request received."/"Transaction complete." pairs at 00:20:54Z-00:21:54Z.

Checkout continued to process orders during the aftermath: its log stream for 00:04:00-00:12:00 contained 244 lines matching payment went through/place order/order received/shipping, and the newest shown lines (00:11:08-00:11:59Z) record "[PlaceOrder]", "order placed", "order confirmation email sent" and successful Kafka writes.

The ERROR-status spans on frontend-proxy were propagated failures on the checkout->payment path: with payment's gRPC server not started until 00:09:15.571Z after the 00:07:57 rollout, checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge spans failed, surfacing as oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder errors in checkout, POST /api/checkout errors in frontend and paired "router frontend egress" + "ingress" errors in frontend-proxy.

The switched-on fault setting paymentUnreachable="on" in otel-demo/flagd-config is the injected fault behind the payment unavailability, with the payment Deployment restart (restartedAt 2026-11-18T00:07:57Z, unchanged pod template image) as its mechanism and the checkout/frontend/frontend-proxy error burst as its consequence; this remains a hypothesis because no controller ties the ConfigMap to the restart and flagd's runtime value was not observable.

The paymentUnreachable setting cannot by itself explain the failures: payment processed charge requests successfully at 00:20:54Z-00:21:54Z and its own ERROR-span series was 0 across the whole sampled hour while the ConfigMap file still reads paymentUnreachable="on"; the Charge failures line up with the 00:08:00-00:09:15 window in which the replacement payment container had not yet started its gRPC server.

The alert's activeAt value 0.022222/s at 00:17:35Z is at background level, not the burst level: the two error compositions differ (ingress-only at 00:17:35Z versus ingress 34.8 plus router frontend egress 34.8 at 00:09:30Z), and the identical ingress-only error pattern already existed pre-incident at 00:03:00Z (ingress 3.333, egress 0), ~8 minutes before the alert's start time.

frontend-proxy is not the origin of the errors: during the deviation its "ingress" and "router frontend egress" error counts were equal (34.8 each in 00:06:30-00:09:30), consistent with the proxy's server errors mirroring failed client calls to frontend, while frontend's own error spans were limited to the /api/checkout and CheckoutService/PlaceOrder operations that call checkout.

The small error rates of ad (1.11 per 5m at 00:02 and again at 00:13), fraud-detection and recommendation are background, not part of this alert: their 2m error rates were 0 at 00:09:30Z, they have no relation to the checkout/payment path, and they neither rose nor fell with the burst.

gaps: The change_history integration is not available, so who or what set kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:07:57Z on Deployment otel-demo/payment, and when the paymentUnreachable value in flagd-config was set, could not be determined.

flagd pod logs for 00:00:00Z-00:30:00Z returned no lines at all (all three containers read 0 bytes), so flagd's runtime flag state and any flag-change events are unknown; only the ConfigMap file content was read, and it is not verified to equal flagd's runtime copy.

Jaeger returned no traces for every attempted window (frontend-proxy 00:05-00:30 and 00:28-00:34 with error=true, checkout 00:05-00:18 and 00:20-00:28, checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 00:08-00:10:30), so no span-level error messages, parent references or complete call chain are available; the call chain above is inferred from operation names and metric labels only.

Application error text is missing: checkout's filtered query for error|fail|unavailable|refused|deadline|rpc over 00:05:00-00:10:00 matched 0 of 3509 read lines, and the frontend container log stream returned 0 bytes for 00:07-00:11.

kube_pod_container_info returned no series at 00:05:00Z or 00:30:00Z, so the old and new payment pod image digests could not be compared and a configuration-only versus image change could not be verified (the image tag ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment is unchanged).
The cronjobs query failed with SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so scheduled chaos/fault-injection jobs could not be ruled out.

No http_server_request_duration_seconds_count or rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count series existed for service_name="frontend-proxy" in the window (both discovery queries returned nothing), so HTTP status-code-level breakdown of the proxy errors is unknown.

list_prometheus_rules returned no_data for rule_name RequestErrorRate, so the expression was read from the rules ConfigMap file rather than from a live rule evaluation, and Alertmanager history (earlier firing/resolve cycles of this alert) is not available.
The old payment pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 no longer exists and its logs were not available, so its shutdown behaviour and the exact last successfully served charge before 00:08:00Z are unknown.
next_steps: Check CI/CD, kubectl audit logs or the change_history source for the actor that applied the 00:07:57Z restart to Deployment otel-demo/payment, and for any edit to ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config, to confirm whether the paymentUnreachable fault was deliberately enabled.

Read flagd's runtime flag state (flagd OFREP/flag evaluation or the flagd-ui on the shared config-rw volume) to verify whether paymentUnreachable is actually being served as "on"; if it should be off, switch it off and validate with a test charge request.
Add readiness/startup probes to the payment container and raise replicas/maxSurge so a single-replica rollout cannot route traffic to a pod whose gRPC server is not yet listening.

Consider tightening the RequestErrorRate rule (threshold above the ingress-only background rate or exclusion of known client-error paths), since it currently fires on any nonzero ERROR-span rate and its reported value at 00:17:35Z was background-level.

groups:
- interval: 1m
  name: ClusterAlerts
  rules:
  - alert: FailedPodsDetected
    annotations:
      description: 'Pods in failed state in namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} is above
        0 (current: {{ $value }})'
    expr: sum by(namespace) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="otel-demo", phase="Failed"})
      > 0
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PendingPodsDetected
    annotations:
      description: 'Pods in pending state in namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} above
        0 (current: {{ $value }})'
    expr: sum by(namespace) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="otel-demo", phase="Pending"})
      > 0
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: CrashLoopBackOffPodsDetected
    annotations:
      description: 'Pods in CrashLoopBackOff state in namespace {{ $labels.namespace
        }} above 0 (current: {{ $value }})'
    expr: sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace="otel-demo",reason="CrashLoopBackOff"})
      > 0
    labels:
      severity: critical
- interval: 1m
  name: GoldenSignalAlerts
  rules:
  - alert: RequestLatency
    annotations:
      description: 'Latency in service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace {{
        $labels.namespace }} is above 1500ms (current: {{ $value }}s)'
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name!~"flagd|load-generator|accounting|fraud-detection"}[2m])))
      > 1500
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: RequestLatencyProcessor
    annotations:
      description: 'Latency in service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace {{
        $labels.namespace }} is above 15000ms (current: {{ $value }}s)'
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~"accounting|fraud-detection"}[2m])))
      > 15000
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: RequestErrorRate
    annotations:
      description: 'Request error rate in service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace
        {{ $labels.namespace }} is above 0 (current: {{ $value }})'
    expr: sum by (service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR",
      service_name!~"flagd|load-generator"}[2m])) > 0
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
- interval: 1m
  name: GoodputAlerts
  rules:
  - alert: NoRequestsDetected
    annotations:
      description: Service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace {{ $labels.namespace
        }} has 0 requests
    expr: sum by (service_name, namespace) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name!~"flagd|load-generator",
      namespace="otel-demo", status_code=~"STATUS_CODE_UNSET|STATUS_CODE_OK"}[2m]))
      == 0
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
- interval: 1m
  name: KafkaAlerts
  rules:
  - alert: KafkaConnectionClosureRate
    annotations:
      description: 'Job {{ $labels.job }} has a closure rate above 0 (current: {{
        $value }})'
    expr: sum by (job) (kafka_consumer_connection_close_rate) > 0
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
